name: Trout
description: Fresh trout from Crownmere. Cook it over a range or campfire.

name: Cooked Trout
description: Trout cooked through over the fire.

name: Burnt Trout
description: Charred through and inedible.

name: Tuna
description: Fresh tuna from Crownmere. Cook it over a range or campfire.

name: Cooked Tuna
description: Tuna cooked through over the fire.

name: Burnt Tuna
description: Charred through and inedible.

name: Salmon
description: Fresh salmon from Pearlwater. Cook it over a range or campfire.

name: Cooked Salmon
description: Salmon cooked through over the fire.

name: Burnt Salmon
description: Charred through and inedible.

name: Gold
description: Plain gold coins. Every shop and settlement takes them.

name: Copper Ore
description: Grey ore, streaked rust-red. Smelts easily, which is the only nice thing about it.

name: Limestone
description: Crumbly limestone from the Copper Pit. Every furnace on the frontier runs on it as flux.

name: Iron Ore
description: Dark deepwood ore. Heavier than it looks and slightly oily on the break.

name: Cobalt Ore
description: Black Highlands ore with a blue fracture. It takes a furnace twice to give anything up.

name: Titanium Ore
description: Rust-orange Ashlands ore, warm off the seam. It smells faintly of a banked fire.

name: Flux Stone
description: Grey-black flux off the Quarry Seams. Titanium refuses to run without it.

name: Pine Log
description: Pale, straight-grained, and dries in a day. The march is short of everything except this.

name: Ash Log
description: Close-grained ash from the Woodlands canopy. Seasoned for strong handles and shields.

name: Oak Log
description: Dense oak with a coarse, durable grain. It holds a Cobalt ferrule without splitting.

name: Walnut Log
description: Dark walnut heartwood from broad, spreading crowns. It cuts cleanly and takes a smooth finish.

name: Minnow
description: A palm-sized fish out of the River shallows. Raw, it is mostly bone.

name: Trout
description: Black-backed trout from the Blackwater pools. Fights the line the whole way in.

name: Perch
description: A slab-sided tarn fish with a spined dorsal. Hillcrest eats little else.

name: Bass
description: A dark-finned spring fish that thrives where the water runs warm. Oily and rich.

name: Copper Bar
description: One ore, one stone, one bar. The first thing anybody makes.

name: Iron Bar
description: Dark and dense. Rings a full tone lower than Copper on the anvil.

name: Cobalt Bar
description: Black with a blue sheen. Holds an edge through cairn stone, which is why Hillcrest exists.

name: Titanium Bar
description: Three ores and two flux stones a bar, and it comes off the furnace still glowing at the core.

name: Quartz
description: A milky chip out of a Copper seam. Holds a charge just long enough to be useful.

name: Amber
description: Fossil resin from under the deepwood. Warm in the hand and nobody knows why.

name: Garnet
description: Deep red, cut square by the rock itself. Hillcrest jewellers cage it in Cobalt.

name: Fire Opal
description: An orange stone with a live spark in it. Ashford cages them in Titanium claws.

name: Pine Shaft
description: A shaved length of pine. Handle, haft, or half a staff.

name: Ash Shaft
description: Ash, turned down and oiled. Will not warp in Woodlands damp.

name: Oak Shaft
description: Resinous, springy, and heavy. Takes a Cobalt ferrule without splitting.

name: Walnut Shaft
description: A straight walnut shaft, shaped and seasoned for rods and staves.

name: Pine Handle
description: A short pine grip, shaped for a Copper tang or tool head.

name: Ash Handle
description: Oiled ash with enough weight to balance an Iron head.

name: Oak Handle
description: Oak shaped around the grain so a Cobalt tang will not split it.

name: Walnut Handle
description: An oiled walnut grip shaped to hold a Titanium tang securely.

name: Coarse Hide
description: Goat and rabbit skins, scraped and salted together. Stiff until you work it.

name: Thick Hide
description: Deepwood deer and hog, thorns still in the seam. Nothing in Woodlands tans clean.

name: Fur Pelt
description: Winter coat off something that lived above the treeline. Takes no dye and does not tear.

name: Heavy Hide
description: Foothill hide seared grey at the edges. Sheds heat the way fur pelt sheds cold.

name: Air Essence
description: A stackable charge drawn from the distant Farmland cache.

name: Earth Essence
description: Dense green-brown essence mined beneath the Woodlands roots.

name: Water Essence
description: Cold blue essence gathered from the far Highlands cache.

name: Fire Essence
description: A hot orange charge mined at the Ashlands altar ruins. It never quite cools.

name: Mind Rune
description: A pale rune etched with a single clear eye. It steadies the caster's thought onto one mark. Rank-one invocations spend one per cast.

name: Chaos Rune
description: An orange rune scored with a jagged fork. It lets a spell break loose and scatter across a line of foes. Rank-two invocations spend one per cast.

name: Death Rune
description: A bone-white rune cut with a hollow skull. It holds a spell's shape while it gathers and closes. Rank-three invocations spend one per cast.

name: Blood Rune
description: A dark red rune with a drop sunk into its face. It feeds invocations heavy enough to batter the ground. Rank-four invocations spend one per cast.

name: Wrath Rune
description: A black rune split through with slow red light. The four finales spend one per cast, and nothing smaller touches it.

name: Cosmic Rune
description: A yellow rune ringed with a wheel of stars. It spreads an invocation across an area. Every area invocation spends one beside its rank rune.

name: Hen Feather
description: Barred brown, still stiff at the quill. Fletchers buy them by the double handful.

name: Hen Egg
description: Warm when you find it, which is how you know you were quick enough.

name: Curled Horn
description: One horn from a goat. Hollow, and loud if you know how to blow it.

name: Ox Horn
description: Short, thick and scarred at the base. Millfield turns them into cups and lamp horn.

name: Rabbit Foot
description: Carried for luck by everyone who has ever admitted the moor frightens them.

name: Marsh Gland
description: Pale sac from behind a frog's jaw. Keeps essence wet, which is most of the trick.

name: Viper Skin
description: Shed whole and inside out. Copper fletchers back their nocks with it.

name: Venom Gland
description: Still full. Handled with the same care you would give a lit lamp in a barn.

name: Stag Antler
description: A six-point stag antler. Cut and polished, it makes a strong knife handle.

name: Curved Tusk
description: Ivory, yellowed, and ground to an edge by the animal's own jaw.

name: Wolf Fang
description: Long in the root, which is the part nobody expects until they pull one.

name: Bear Claw
description: Longer than a finger and blunt from stone. Hillcrest hangs them over doorways.

name: Boar Bristle
description: A fistful of black wire off a wild boar's shoulder. It will not lie flat.

name: Ibex Horn
description: Ridged the whole length, one ring a winter. This one counted eleven.

name: Aurochs Horn
description: As long as your arm and heavier. The terrace herds are the last ones anywhere.

name: Rat Tail
description: Stone Cavern pays a bounty per tail. Nobody in Hillcrest asks what the count is for.

name: Scorpion Stinger
description: Barb and bulb both intact. Dry, it is a needle; wet, it is still a problem.

name: Crab Claw
description: Off a giant crab, and big enough to have taken a pick handle in half.

name: Dire Bear Claw
description: Grey to the root, like the bear it came off. Ashford doors hang two, crossed.

name: Dire Boar Tusk
description: A boar tusk stained kiln-black. The point still goes through boot leather.

name: Large Ibex Horn
description: Ridged ibex horn with a red cast the foothill dust never washes out of.

name: Giant Viper Fang
description: An viper fang the colour of cooling slag. Hot to the touch for a day after the kill.

name: Raw Game Meat
description: Whatever the Farmland was carrying. Fowl, goat or rabbit, jointed the same way.

name: Roast Game
description: Turned over a range until the fat stops running. Frontier cooking, and it works.

name: Burnt Game
description: Left on the range. Black through and nothing left worth eating.

name: Raw Venison
description: Dark, close-grained deepwood meat. Hangs two days before it is worth cooking.

name: Roast Venison
description: Seared hard and rested. The one meal in Oakwood nobody complains about.

name: Burnt Venison
description: A stag walked all summer for this and you left it on the coals.

name: Raw Haunch
description: A whole hind quarter off something that lived above the treeline. Heavy.

name: Roast Haunch
description: Four hours over Hillcrest coals. It is a meal and most of a day's carrying.

name: Burnt Haunch
description: Ruined, and it was the biggest thing you killed all week.

name: Raw Prime Haunch
description: A hind quarter off a foothill beast, marbled from a life spent on warm ground.

name: Roast Prime Haunch
description: Cooked slow over walnut coals. Ashford calls it a wage, not a meal.

name: Burnt Prime Haunch
description: The one place in Ashlands where more fire was not the answer.

name: Seared Minnow
description: Two minutes over a range and it stops being mostly bone.

name: Burnt Minnow
description: Charred through. Nothing left worth eating.

name: Seared Trout
description: Split, salted, and laid on the stone. Oakwood's entire cuisine.

name: Burnt Trout
description: You left it on. It happens until Cooking 20.

name: Seared Perch
description: The reason anyone survives Quarry Warden's floor. Hillcrest will not sell you fewer than five.

name: Burnt Perch
description: Ninety-six gold of fish, ruined. Hillcrest has opinions about this.

name: Seared Bass
description: The oil crisps its own skin. What a Fire Ogre attempt is provisioned with.

name: Burnt Bass
description: It cooked itself the rest of the way while you watched.

name: Worn Pickaxe
description: The head is loose and the haft is somebody's fence post. One effective Mining level.

name: Worn Hatchet
description: More wedge than edge. It will get through pine if you are patient.

name: Worn Rod
description: A green stick and a length of gut. One effective Fishing level, on a good day.

name: Copper Pickaxe
description: A bar of Copper on an pine haft. Adds two effective Mining levels.

name: Iron Pickaxe
description: Iron head, ash haft. Five effective Mining levels.

name: Cobalt Pickaxe
description: Cobalt on oak. Nine effective Mining levels, and it will outlive you.

name: Copper Hatchet
description: Light, blunt-ish, and enough for pine. Two effective Woodcutting levels.

name: Iron Hatchet
description: Iron bit, deep bevel. Five effective Woodcutting levels.

name: Cobalt Hatchet
description: Goes through oak resin without gumming. Nine effective Woodcutting levels.

name: Pine Rod
description: A shaft, a hide line, and a bent pin. Two effective Fishing levels.

name: Ash Rod
description: Springy enough for a trout. Five effective Fishing levels.

name: Oak Rod
description: Built for perch, which fight like something with a grudge. Nine effective Fishing levels.

name: Titanium Pickaxe
description: An Titanium head on walnut. Seventeen effective Mining levels.

name: Titanium Hatchet
description: Bites through scorched bark without a second swing. Seventeen effective Woodcutting levels.

name: Walnut Rod
description: A flexible walnut rod built for heavy bass. Seventeen effective Fishing levels.

name: Willow Log
description: Timber cut from a willow tree.

name: Maple Log
description: Timber cut from a maple tree.

name: Teak Log
description: Timber cut from a teak tree.

name: Yew Log
description: Timber cut from a yew tree.

name: Magic Log
description: Timber cut from a magic tree.

name: Air Orb
description: A region-boss core used to craft a charged Air wand or staff.

name: Earth Orb
description: A region-boss core used to craft a charged Earth wand or staff.

name: Water Orb
description: A region-boss core used to craft a charged Water wand or staff.

name: Fire Orb
description: A region-boss core used to craft a charged Fire wand or staff.

name: Cobalt Garnet Ring
description: A ring set with cairn garnet. Grants only melee accuracy.

name: Cobalt Garnet Earring
description: A earring set with cairn garnet. Grants only melee accuracy.

name: Titanium Opal Ring
description: A ring set with fire opal. Grants only magic accuracy.

name: Titanium Opal Earring
description: A earring set with fire opal. Grants only magic accuracy.

name: Dewglass Quartz Ring
description: A ring set with pale quartz. Grants only defence.

name: Dewglass Quartz Earring
description: A earring set with pale quartz. Grants only defence.

name: Titanium Amber Ring
description: A ring set with vell amber. Grants only health.

name: Titanium Amber Earring
description: A earring set with vell amber. Grants only health.

name: Cindersteel Garnet Ring
description: A ring set with cairn garnet. Grants only melee power.

name: Cindersteel Garnet Earring
description: A earring set with cairn garnet. Grants only melee power.

name: Cindersteel Opal Ring
description: A ring set with fire opal. Grants only magic power.

name: Cindersteel Opal Earring
description: A earring set with fire opal. Grants only magic power.

name: Nightglass Opal Ring
description: A ring set with fire opal. Grants only vitality, critical hit chance.

name: Nightglass Opal Earring
description: A earring set with fire opal. Grants only vitality, critical hit chance.

name: Worn Shortsword
description: Notched, re-hafted twice, and lighter than it looks. It was somebody else's first.

name: Basic Wooden Wand
description: Plain brown wood from grip to socket, with no light or elemental charge.

name: Basic Wooden Staff
description: A plain two-handed staff with an empty brown socket and no glow of its own.

name: Worn Helm
description: A dented cap off somebody's scrap pile. It rattles, and it is better than bare.

name: Worn Cuirass
description: Two salvaged plates laced over old leather. The only piece of this kit that stops anything.

name: Worn Greaves
description: Mismatched shin plates tied on with cord.

name: Worn Gloves
description: Cracked leather gloves with the stitching gone at one thumb.

name: Worn Boots
description: Split-soled boots. They keep the stones out, mostly.

name: Worn Hide Hood
description: A hood cut from a hide nobody wanted. It still smells of the shed.

name: Worn Hide Robe
description: Offcuts stitched into a robe. The only piece here with enough hide to turn a claw.

name: Worn Hide Leggings
description: Hide leggings, patched at both knees.

name: Worn Hide Wraps
description: Hide strips wound over the knuckles. They keep the grip dry.

name: Worn Hide Boots
description: Soft hide boots gone thin at the heel.

name: Air Wand
description: Pine Wand fitted with a Air Orb. Its charge pays for matching spells before carried Essence.

name: Air Staff
description: Pine Staff fitted with a Air Orb. Its charge pays for matching spells before carried Essence.

name: Earth Wand
description: Ash Wand fitted with a Earth Orb. Its charge pays for matching spells before carried Essence.

name: Earth Staff
description: Ash Staff fitted with a Earth Orb. Its charge pays for matching spells before carried Essence.

name: Water Wand
description: Oak Wand fitted with a Water Orb. Its charge pays for matching spells before carried Essence.

name: Water Staff
description: Oak Staff fitted with a Water Orb. Its charge pays for matching spells before carried Essence.

name: Fire Wand
description: Walnut Wand fitted with a Fire Orb. Its charge pays for matching spells before carried Essence.

name: Fire Staff
description: Walnut Staff fitted with a Fire Orb. Its charge pays for matching spells before carried Essence.

name: Fox Fur
description: Coarse red hair from a fox's back. Bind it around a Copper band for a padded guard ring.

name: Lynx Sinew
description: Springy tendon, cleaned and dried. A tight winding gives a hunter's ring its grip.

name: Badger Bristle
description: Stiff black and silver bristles. Worked into leg linings, they save a sheet of hide.

name: Porcupine Quill
description: A thick hollow quill with a hard point. Short sections can be set around a guard ring.

name: Horsehair
description: Long strong strands. Braided into fishing line, they replace a rod's hide binding.

name: Bighorn Wool
description: Dense wool from a ridge ram. A felted lining stretches a pelt into a pair of leggings.

name: Moose Antler
description: A flat antler section. Cut and polished, it makes a broad protective charm.

name: Tapir Leather
description: Thick strips from a tapir's flank. Trim three strips into two standard hide sheets.

name: Crocodile Armor Plate
description: A hard plate from a crocodile's back. Scute soles let one pelt cover two pairs of boots.

name: Salamander Secretion
description: A heat-stable mineral paste. Ashford uses it instead of mined flux stone.

name: Tortoise Shell Plate
description: A curved shell section. Lash several across a wooden shield in place of its metal boss.

name: Monitor Lizard Sinew
description: Heat-tough tendon from a monitor's tail. Twisted into line, it binds a Cedar rod.

name: Goose Down
description: Soft breast feathers. Pack them between hide panels to finish a robe with less leather.

name: Heron Quill
description: A long hollow flight quill. Cut around an amber bead, it steadies a casting charm.

name: Bustard Plume
description: A broad feather from a heavy moorland bird. Layered plumes replace a robe's inner pelt.

name: Turkey Tail Feather
description: A barred tail feather. Millfield hunters bind a fan of them around a small warding charm.

name: Snail Mucus
description: A sealed dab of clear adhesive. It bonds a wooden shield's layers in place of a metal boss.

name: Beetle Jaw
description: A hooked jaw hard enough to score stone. Several brace a pick head with less metal.

name: Centipede Chitin
description: Dark overlapping plates. Small segments fit an armored ring without spoiling its grip.

name: Spider Silk
description: A reel of strong dry silk. Close stitching makes a full robe from fewer hide panels.

name: Demon Claw
description: A hooked black claw. Cut down, it replaces the wooden grip beneath a Titanium blade.

name: Armored Dragon Scale
description: A broad scale with a tough leather backing. Trim several into standard heavy hide sheets.

name: Mantis Claw
description: A curved cutting spur. Its sharpened edge can be caged inside an aggressive hunting charm.

name: Pale Dragon Plate
description: A ridged shoulder plate. Riveted over a helm, it replaces part of the Cobalt shell.

name: Cindervein Ore
description: Black ore shot through with copper-red seams. Smelt three with a Molten Heart into Cindersteel.

name: Nightglass Ore
description: Violet ore with a blue fracture. Smelt three with an Astral Core into a Nightglass Bar.

name: Cindersteel Bar
description: Dense dark steel cast with a molten stone heart. Used for level 50 armour, weapons and tools.

name: Nightglass Bar
description: A solid bar of blue-black glass metal. Used for level 70 armour, weapons and tools.

name: Molten Heart
description: A cooled kernel from a living stone creature. It replaces flux when smelting Cindersteel.

name: Dragonhide
description: Supple hide beneath a young dragon's scales. Grave Thread binds it into level 50 casting armour.

name: Grave Thread
description: Black binding drawn from the Wilderness dead. Stitch Dragonhide or wind it into a Teak casting weapon.

name: Astral Core
description: A blue-violet heart from a deep Wilderness creature. It fuses Nightglass Ore without shattering it.

name: Starhide
description: Adult dragon hide steeped in deep magic. Void Thread stitches it into level 70 casting armour.

name: Void Thread
description: A dark strand pulled from a deep spirit. Binds Starhide and the crowns of Magic casting weapons.

name: Teak Handle
description: Oiled teak cut for a Cindersteel sword, pickaxe or hatchet.

name: Magic Handle
description: A carved magic-wood grip for Nightglass weapons and gathering tools.

name: Ashseal Iron
description: The Ashseal Warden's dense shield iron. Rivet it across a Teak Shield to make an Ashseal Guard.

name: Furnace Crown
description: A piece of the Furnace Regent's crucible crown. Set three around a Teak Staff to make a Regent Staff.

name: Chainbound Link
description: A living link carried by the foundry guard and Chainbound Archon. Three bind a Nightglass Sword into a Chainbound Sword.

name: Nightforge Seal
description: A breastplate stamp taken from the bastion guard or Nightforge Marshal. Reinforces Nightglass Plate into Nightmarshal Plate.

name: Hollow Star Fragment
description: A heavy black shard carried by the sanctum guard and Hollow Star. Three form the crown of a Hollowstar Staff.

name: Ashseal Guard
description: The Ashseal Warden's iron spread across a Teak Shield. A heavy guard for close fighting.

name: Regent Staff
description: Three pieces of the Furnace Regent's crown brace a Teak Staff. Casts through carried Essence.

name: Chainbound Sword
description: Living foundry chain wound through a Nightglass blade. The edge tightens under a full swing.

name: Nightmarshal Plate
description: Nightglass Plate reinforced with the bastion's old seals. Heavy overlapping ribs protect the chest.

name: Hollowstar Staff
description: Three fragments of the Hollow Star turn above a magic-wood shaft. Casts through carried Essence.

name: Chitin Duskguard Plate
description: Chitin Duskguard plate for level 50 Melee. A rare boss reward.

name: Chitin Duskguard Greaves
description: Chitin Duskguard greaves for level 50 Melee. A rare boss reward.

name: Chitin Duskguard Gauntlets
description: Chitin Duskguard gauntlets for level 50 Melee. A rare boss reward.

name: Chitin Duskguard Boots
description: Chitin Duskguard boots for level 50 Melee. A rare boss reward.

name: Void Oathguard Plate
description: Void Oathguard plate for level 70 Melee. A rare boss reward.

name: Void Oathguard Greaves
description: Void Oathguard greaves for level 70 Melee. A rare boss reward.

name: Void Oathguard Gauntlets
description: Void Oathguard gauntlets for level 70 Melee. A rare boss reward.

name: Void Oathguard Boots
description: Void Oathguard boots for level 70 Melee. A rare boss reward.

name: Aurora Frostguard Helm
description: Aurora Frostguard helm for level 90 Melee.

name: Aurora Frostguard Plate
description: Aurora Frostguard plate for level 90 Melee.

name: Aurora Frostguard Greaves
description: Aurora Frostguard greaves for level 90 Melee.

name: Aurora Frostguard Gauntlets
description: Aurora Frostguard gauntlets for level 90 Melee.

name: Aurora Frostguard Boots
description: Aurora Frostguard boots for level 90 Melee.

name: Chitin Tideweave Headwrap
description: Chitin Tideweave headwrap for level 50 Magic. A rare boss reward.

name: Chitin Tideweave Robe
description: Chitin Tideweave robe for level 50 Magic. A rare boss reward.

name: Chitin Tideweave Leggings
description: Chitin Tideweave leggings for level 50 Magic. A rare boss reward.

name: Chitin Tideweave Wraps
description: Chitin Tideweave wraps for level 50 Magic. A rare boss reward.

name: Chitin Tideweave Boots
description: Chitin Tideweave boots for level 50 Magic. A rare boss reward.

name: Void Nightweave Headwrap
description: Void Nightweave headwrap for level 70 Magic. A rare boss reward.

name: Void Nightweave Robe
description: Void Nightweave robe for level 70 Magic. A rare boss reward.

name: Void Nightweave Leggings
description: Void Nightweave leggings for level 70 Magic. A rare boss reward.

name: Void Nightweave Wraps
description: Void Nightweave wraps for level 70 Magic. A rare boss reward.

name: Void Nightweave Boots
description: Void Nightweave boots for level 70 Magic. A rare boss reward.

name: Aurora Frostweave Hood
description: Aurora Frostweave hood for level 90 Magic.

name: Aurora Frostweave Robe
description: Aurora Frostweave robe for level 90 Magic.

name: Aurora Frostweave Leggings
description: Aurora Frostweave leggings for level 90 Magic.

name: Aurora Frostweave Wraps
description: Aurora Frostweave wraps for level 90 Magic.

name: Aurora Frostweave Boots
description: Aurora Frostweave boots for level 90 Magic.

name: Brambleguard Ring
description: A rare ring carried by minibosses. Its paired ring and earring carry the same bonuses.

name: Brambleguard Earring
description: A rare earring carried by minibosses. Its paired ring and earring carry the same bonuses.

name: Moonsigil Ring
description: A rare ring carried by minibosses. Its paired ring and earring carry the same bonuses.

name: Moonsigil Earring
description: A rare earring carried by minibosses. Its paired ring and earring carry the same bonuses.

name: Hollow Crown Ring
description: A rare ring carried by minibosses. Its paired ring and earring carry the same bonuses.

name: Hollow Crown Earring
description: A rare earring carried by minibosses. Its paired ring and earring carry the same bonuses.

name: Thornstrike Ring
description: A rare ring carried by minibosses. Its paired ring and earring carry the same bonuses.

name: Thornstrike Earring
description: A rare earring carried by minibosses. Its paired ring and earring carry the same bonuses.

name: Nightbloom Ring
description: A rare ring carried by minibosses. Its paired ring and earring carry the same bonuses.

name: Nightbloom Earring
description: A rare earring carried by minibosses. Its paired ring and earring carry the same bonuses.

name: Stoneheart Ring
description: A rare ring carried by minibosses. Its paired ring and earring carry the same bonuses.

name: Stoneheart Earring
description: A rare earring carried by minibosses. Its paired ring and earring carry the same bonuses.

name: Veilweaver Ring
description: A rare ring carried by minibosses. Its paired ring and earring carry the same bonuses.

name: Veilweaver Earring
description: A rare earring carried by minibosses. Its paired ring and earring carry the same bonuses.

name: Dewglass Ore
description: Translucent turquoise mineral-metal with pearly silver edges, overlapping leaf-shaped plates and dark leather straps. Rough mineral fragments in a dark stone matrix; smelt three into one bar.

name: Dewglass Bar
description: Translucent turquoise mineral-metal with pearly silver edges, overlapping leaf-shaped plates and dark leather straps. A solid cast ingot with beveled ends and a stamped maker's mark.

name: Mistweave
description: Layered blue-green cloth with pointed petal panels, pale embroidered seams and softly shaded folds. A folded bolt with a visible woven edge. Cut into garments or binding thread.

name: Mistweave Thread
description: Fine Mistweave thread wound around a carved wooden spool. Used for seams, casting grips and fishing line.

name: Willow Handle
description: Pale willow with bent flowing grain, turquoise bindings and pearly silver Dewglass fittings. A shaped grip with a shouldered tang socket for swords, pickaxes and hatchets.

name: Crownsilver Ore
description: Ivory silver with shaped fluting, brass fasteners and a dark navy underlayer. Rough mineral fragments in a dark stone matrix; smelt three into one bar.

name: Crownsilver Bar
description: Ivory silver with shaped fluting, brass fasteners and a dark navy underlayer. A solid cast ingot with beveled ends and a stamped maker's mark.

name: Crownhide
description: Cream and tan pebbled leather with dark blue gussets, brass buckles, braided leather borders and visible saddle stitching. A folded tanned hide with a natural irregular edge. Cut into garments or binding thread.

name: Crownhide Lacing
description: Narrow tan leather lacing braided around an ivory spool. Used for seams, casting grips and fishing line.

name: Maple Handle
description: Amber-red maple with figured grain, warm leather grips and silver and brass fittings. A shaped grip with a shouldered tang socket for swords, pickaxes and hatchets.

name: Star Amethyst Ore
description: Dark violet crystalline metal with blue-violet depths, sharp facets and silver branching inlay. Rough mineral fragments in a dark stone matrix; smelt three into one bar.

name: Star Amethyst Bar
description: Dark violet crystalline metal with blue-violet depths, sharp facets and silver branching inlay. A solid cast ingot with beveled ends and a stamped maker's mark.

name: Faesilk
description: Lavender and teal silk with silver embroidery, layered pointed hems and silver closures. A folded bolt with a visible woven edge. Cut into garments or binding thread.

name: Faesilk Thread
description: Fine Faesilk thread wound around a carved wooden spool. Used for seams, casting grips and fishing line.

name: Yew Handle
description: Reddish yew heartwood with pale sapwood edges, teal bindings and silver and amethyst fittings. A shaped grip with a shouldered tang socket for swords, pickaxes and hatchets.

name: Melee Potion 1
description: Raises melee by 5 for five minutes.

name: Melee Potion 2
description: Raises melee by 10 for five minutes.

name: Melee Potion 3
description: Raises melee by 15 for five minutes.

name: Melee Potion 4
description: Raises melee by 20 for five minutes.

name: Magic Potion 1
description: Raises magic by 5 for five minutes.

name: Magic Potion 2
description: Raises magic by 10 for five minutes.

name: Magic Potion 3
description: Raises magic by 15 for five minutes.
